newsitem.title: USA: Netframe sees Q4 loss larger than Q3.
newsitem.headline: Netframe sees Q4 loss larger than Q3.

text.p: NetFRAME Systems Inc expects to report an operating loss for the fourth quarter that is larger than $7.9 million loss reported in the third quarter. It also said fourth quarter revenues would be lower than the third quarter.
The company reported net income in the third quarter of $7.7 million, or $0.56 a share.
It said it expects results on January 28.
NetFRAME said the expected increased losses are due mainly to costs associated with its major product transition from its NF8500 line of servers to its recently introduced ClusterSystem 9000 line.
NetFRAME makes servers that support the Microsoft Windows NT Server and Novell NetWare environments.
